detail: intake: located the sdd project spec, resolved the CR to doctrine/scanner (revise, frozen suite present). Ran the repo's own validate-before-draft gate on the CR's motivating claim before scoping.

note: The CR's requested realization contradicts a deliberate declared contract, and its stated mechanism does not exist. A sweep of every consumer shows nothing reads a plan brief's top-level status for lifecycle: the sole parser carries it verbatim behind an opt-in caller filter, the retirement sweep decides on caller clearance plus plan presence plus a distilling ledger entry, and the doctrine distill keys on the spec's terminal transition and the distills field. Flipping a brief to a terminal value therefore makes it visible to no consumer, refuting the CR's premise that the flip is what exposes a plan to the existing distill step. Separately, the design record declares the plan-level status as a two-value dispatch flag and carries an explicit do-not-conflate rule naming the contract lifecycle enum as the one not to borrow, so the requested values are off-enum by intent rather than by oversight. Both sides are plausibly intended, so this is a Conflict floor rather than a stale-mistake minor fix, and the choice among widening the enum, writing off-enum anyway, or deriving the retirement clearance set instead is a doctrine decision above the chore tier this run was leashed for. Halting before the spec gate rather than freezing a scenario that encodes the contradiction. The detect-and-flag half of the request is uncontested; only the autofix half is blocked.

detail: Owner resolved the halt with Option C (derive the retirement clearance set; drop the status write). Ran the spec-producer role inline per sdd:spec-producer-governance and authored a new additive Stale plan frontmatter band in scanner.feature (7 scenarios) plus a matching README section and Use Cases row. Self-checked with check-suite.mts and check-spec-state.mts (both OK) and classify-edit-class.mts (ADDITIVE, 0 modified/removed).

Revision pass after cold spec-judge SCENARIOS_FAILING (oracle/builder/architect all fail on S3/S4: "surfaces a flagged finding ... in its report" collided with the reserved kind:report ledger line and this same spec own frozen Non-goals, and left the finding shape unspecified). Reworded S3/S4 to name the surfacing channel precisely (the Scanner pass summary to the invoking session, its final message per the post-hoc/no-live-context invariant), added a new scenario asserting a flagged finding is neither kind strategy nor kind report and is distinct from the validated-open-improvement finding, and added a README paragraph giving the flagged finding an explicit non-ledger, ephemeral shape. Re-ran check-suite.mts, check-spec-state.mts, classify-edit-class.mts (still ADDITIVE, now 8 scenarios).
